title: Electing to Carry a Granite Ridge Season Pass Forward to a Later Season
content:
## The request this facility answers

A household asks for a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass to be carried forward, giving up the rest of this winter and taking the pass to a named later season instead. The fee for carrying a pass forward is worked out only after the pass record stands in the state in which it admits the holder. The fee is the figure the collective's basis for a carry-forward fee produces; the agent works it out from the records and the published terms and passes it in.

## The business effect

The pass record moves to the carried-forward state and is stamped with the season it now belongs to, the fee for the election is booked on the pass account dated today, and the amount still to be collected rises by that fee, so the pass stops admitting the holder this winter and comes back for the season named.

## How it is invoked

Giving up the rest of the winter on the household's own pass is the holder's own election. The agent unlocks the hidden tool `elect_pass_carry_forward_09e30d1a` and hands it over, and it is run by the customer themselves.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pass_id` | the reference number of the season pass record being carried forward | an identifier, as returned by the season pass lookup |
| `next_season_code` | the season the pass is carried to | written as the collective writes a season, YYYY-YY, for instance 2027-28, with no spaces and no other punctuation; an empty value is not accepted |
| `carry_forward_fee_usd` | the fee placed on the pass account for the election | a fixed-format figure in USD to 2 decimal places, never negative and booked at exactly the figure given |

No parameter carries an enumerated set of values.

## What comes back

A confirmation sentence carrying the new pass account entry reference, a string beginning `pcfw_`, the pass record reference, the season the pass now belongs to, the fee booked in USD to 2 decimal places and the amount still to be collected on that pass account afterwards, also in USD to 2 decimal places. The presence of that entry reference is what indicates the election was recorded.

## Contract questions

*What must the pass record stand at before the fee is worked out?* The state in which it admits the holder; the fee is worked out only after the record stands there.

*Does the tool judge whether the tier offers a carry-forward?* No. It stamps the season, books the fee at exactly the figure given and moves the record.
